normalizer_shift_on_landforms.reading: a minmax scale fitted on stylised icons does not bound natural coastlines; the Euclidean distance in E1 is then partly a distance *outside* the fitted range, which is a property of this corpus choice, not of the descriptors

queries_off_rank_one.verdict: not an implementation error: an empty salient sequence aligns with an empty salient sequence at cost 0.0 by definition, so every shape with no measurable turning sits in one tie of 5 rows and the stable tie-break, not the score, decides who is first

zero_distance_top_hits.reading: distance 0.0 here is a property of two empty salient-event sequences aligning at cost 0, not a claim that the two outlines agree; where all_candidates_eventless is true the metric has simply run out of signal, and where same_contour_as_query is true the gallery handed the arm its own contour back under a different id, which no metric could score differently

deletion_vs_match.gap_cost_reading: a dropped query event costs its own signed turning, so the DP compares |magnitude of the lost corner| against the sum of the pair costs it would have paid to match it; deletion wins whenever that comparison is cheap
